description:
Direct Supply is building the future of healthcare technology with industry-leading products, solutions, and platforms to help improve the lives of millions of seniors and those who care for them.   
   
 As an Associate Product Engineer, you'll support the quality, reliability, and performance of Direct Supply's products through technical product support, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement. You'll apply engineering principles to investigate product questions, evaluate quality information, and help resolve issues that impact customers and product performance.   
   
 Working across multiple product categories, you'll collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Product Management, and other teams to maintain accurate technical information, support product improvements, and deliver practical solutions. Your work will help ensure products meet customer needs while building the technical expertise needed to support an evolving product portfolio.   
   
 What You'll Do and Impact:   
 Provide technical product support by responding to presale and postsale questions from customers and internal teams, helping ensure accurate product selection, use, and issue resolution.   
 Support sustaining engineering activities across multiple product categories, applying engineering knowledge to maintain product quality, functionality, and reliability.   
 Investigate product issues by gathering technical information, reviewing product performance, and supporting troubleshooting efforts to identify potential causes and recommend next steps.   
 Analyze product quality metrics to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve product performance and customer satisfaction.   
 Conduct product compatibility testing to evaluate how products and components function together, document results, and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.   
 Create and maintain technical product documentation, including specifications, product support resources, and other engineering information, to improve accuracy and usability.   
 Review applicable product regulations and testing standards to support accurate technical guidance and help ensure product information reflects relevant requirements.   
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to research product questions, resolve issues, and support improvements that enhance product quality and customer experience.   
 Support product improvement initiatives by gathering information, evaluating potential solutions, and assisting with testing and implementation to improve existing products.   
 Coordinate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to obtain technical information, investigate product concerns, and support timely resolution of quality or performance issues.   
   
 What You'll Bring:   
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, with the ability to apply engineering principles to product testing, troubleshooting, and technical problem-solving.   
 Ability to analyze technical information, product performance data, and quality metrics to identify issues and recommend practical solutions.   
 Understanding of engineering fundamentals, including product functionality, materials, testing methods, or design principles, to support products across multiple categories.   
 Ability to conduct product testing, document results accurately, and communicate findings that support engineering and product decisions.   
 Ability to create and maintain clear, accurate technical documentation for internal teams and customer support.   
 Ability to communicate technical product information clearly to customers, suppliers, and cross-functional stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge.   
 Ability to manage multiple requests, organize priorities, and complete assignments accurately while adapting to changing business and customer needs.   
 Ability to travel occasionally by car or plane to customer or supplier locations to support product quality evaluations and troubleshooting. 
 Job to be performed in the location listed. Generous benefit package available.
